items.title: I’m not sure why so many people are missing the point of this tweet. It’s simple. Because he’s Chinese, he has detailed knowledge of the massive supply chain being built out in China to support Bloom Energy. He knows that Bloom Energy is expanding capacity like crazy, which is why he’s bullish. My poor English seems to have caused some misunderstanding.
items.content:
I’m not sure why so many people are missing the point of this tweet.

It’s simple. Because he’s Chinese, he has detailed knowledge of the massive supply chain being built out in China to support Bloom Energy. He knows that Bloom Energy is expanding capacity like crazy, which is why he’s bullish.

My poor English seems to have caused some misunderstanding.Jukan (@jukan05)Yesterday, I met a Chinese buy-side investor who was extremely bullish on Bloom Energy, and I asked him, “Why Bloom Energy, of all companies?”

He told me it was because much of Bloom Energy’s supply chain is in China, which makes it relatively easy for him to track. He also said that Bloom sources most of the much-discussed scandium from China as well.

*This is not my own view.—  https://x.com/jukan05/status/2091187207524794481 
— Jukan (@jukan05) Aug 22, 2026
